patch_description: Replace the pure pattern search with simulated annealing on coordinated bottleneck-triangle gradient moves plus stochastic kicks, and add basin-hopping restarts (reheat from best-so-far) inside each seed. The current program plateaus at 0.02 (score 0.55); the annealer with reheats targets the known better optimum (~0.0365). Keep runtime bounded by a fixed iteration budget and vectorized min-area evaluation.
